basic_details.job_title: KUFOS Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Fisheries & Ocean Studies (KUFOS) invites applications for empanelment as Guest Faculty in 20 subjects under four faculties, at KUFOS HQ and CoF, Payyannur. Applications go in the prescribed format, by post, to The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O., Pin - 682 506. The last date is 14 December 2026, on or before 4.30 pm. Remuneration is Rs. 1500/- per hour for theory and Rs. 750/- per hour for practical.

The 55% eligibility marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale where grading is followed) and the 5% relaxation are based only on the qualifying marks, without any grace mark procedure. content_sections.heading: About KUFOS
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Fisheries & Ocean Studies is a university at Panangad P.O., Kochi 682 506, Kerala. The guest faculty panel is for its HQ and CoF, Payyannur. It covers four faculties: Fisheries Science, Ocean Science and Technology, Fisheries Engineering and Fisheries Management. The notification is signed by the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be in the prescribed format attached to the notification. They are sent by post to: The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O., Pin - 682 506 The application form asks for the following details: Name of post applied for, and the notification number and date. Personal details: name in English block letters, date of birth, age, sex, marital status, nationality, category (General/OBC/SC/ST), father's name, permanent and correspondence addresses, phone, mobile and e-mail. Qualifications (UG, PG, NET/SLET, PhD) with name of institution, % of marks/OGPA and class/rank. Additional qualification, list of publications and teaching experience (institution, post held, period). Details of present job, and the name and address of the present employer. A signed declaration with date and place.

content_sections.heading: KUFOS Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notification gives one set of duties for all subjects: Empanelled guest faculty have to attend duties related to academic and examination. During exigencies, or on direction of the Dean of the concerned faculties or of the University, they shall attend full day duty. No additional honorarium shall be claimed for additional duties entrusted by the Dean of Faculty or by the university.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Copies of certificates to prove essential educational qualification (with mark list). Proof of age. Proof of experience, and proof of teaching experience in the concerned field. Copies of mark lists and degree certificates for UG, PG, NET/SLET and PhD. Proof of additional qualification, if any, and proof of publications. Particulars of application fee paid (UTR No., date and amount). A recent photograph, affixed on the form and self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are called for an interview. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview, on the basis of qualifications/suitability to the post with the experience prescribed in the notification. The notification attaches "Table 3A: Criteria for short-listing of Candidates for Interview for the Post of Assistant Professors in Universities", reproduced below. If teaching/post doctoral experience is less than one year, the marks are reduced proportionately. Maximum marks: M.Phil + Ph.D 30; JRF/NET/SET 07; awards 03. The number of candidates called for interview shall be decided by the concerned Universities. Total of 100: Academic Score 80, Research Publications 10, Teaching Experience 10. The score shall be valid for appointment in respective State SLET/SET Universities/Colleges/Institutions only.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for KUFOS Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by post on or before 4.30 pm on 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for KUFOS Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The requirement varies by subject. Fisheries Science subjects need an MFSc in the listed specialisation, ICAR/UGC/CSIR NET or PhD, and an ICAR-approved Bachelor degree in Fisheries Science. Most other subjects need a Master's degree with at least 55% marks and NET/SLET or a similar test, or PhD.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for KUFOS Guest Faculty 2026?
faq.answer: The notification gives the age limit as "As per UGC Guidelines".

faq.question: Q4. What is the remuneration for KUFOS Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Remuneration is Rs. 1500/- per hour for theory and Rs. 750/- per hour for practical. It is subject to a maximum of Rs.3000/- per day and Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1500/- for candidates other than SC/ST and Rs. 375/- for SC/ST candidates. It is paid online to Account No. 67149674791 (Finance Officer, KUFOS) and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for KUFOS Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed form by post, with certificate copies and fee proof, to The Registrar, Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies, Panangad P.O., Pin - 682 506. Superscribe the advertisement number and the post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. How are guest faculty selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are called for an interview. The University may restrict the number called on the basis of qualifications/suitability and experience. The attached Table 3A scores academic record (80), research publications (10) and teaching experience (10).

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one subject?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application must be submitted for each post, with the application fee paid accordingly.

faq.question: Q9. Is NET compulsory for PhD holders?
faq.answer: No. NET/SET/SLET is not required for candidates possessing a PhD Degree as per UGC Regulations/ICAR Guidelines. It is also not required in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET has not been conducted.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the KUFOS guest faculty panel valid?
faq.answer: The empanelled list is valid for three year. Deployment of empanelled guest faculty is limited to requirement.
